title: Toolbox user guide
subtitle: Scan, merge, split, compress and copy text out of documents, entirely on your phone. No account, no upload.
author: Mabs SD
intro:
This guide walks through everything Toolbox does, one task per page. Each page shows the real screens with numbered steps, and the same steps written underneath.

Everything happens on your phone. Toolbox has no internet permission, so your files never leave the device. File names in the pictures are examples.

sections.title: Getting started
sections.summary: Three quick pages on first launch, then you are on Home.

sections.title: Finding your way around
sections.summary: What is on the Home screen and where each tab takes you.

sections.title: Scan paper to a PDF
sections.summary: Photograph pages, clean them up and export one PDF.

sections.title: Merge PDFs
sections.summary: Join several PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.

sections.title: Split out pages
sections.summary: Pull the pages you need out of a PDF into a new file.

sections.title: Shrink a file to fit a size limit
sections.summary: Pick a target size and Toolbox compresses until it fits.

sections.title: Copy text from a photo
sections.summary: Turn a photo of a page into text you can paste anywhere.

sections.title: Find, share and delete files
sections.summary: Everything you make is kept in Files, newest first.

sections.title: Open files from other apps
sections.summary: Share a PDF or image to Toolbox, then pick a tool.

sections.title: Light, dark and privacy
sections.summary: Pick a theme, and see why your files stay on your phone.
